verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents BM25-based full-text search and a dedicated hybrid search method that combines multiple search techniques. Its reranking docs show running hybrid search over an FTS index plus vector search, with a reranker to improve relevance. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the fusion algorithm (e.g. RRF/weighted fusion), learned sparse-vector support beyond BM25, independent hands-on corroboration.
